CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_USER ( USER_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT , CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL , UPDATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL , ENABLED INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL , ROLE TEXT NOT NULL , UID TEXT NOT NULL , PROVIDER TEXT NOT NULL , ID TEXT NOT NULL , EMAIL TEXT DEFAULT NULL , NICKNAME TEXT DEFAULT NULL , PROFILE_IMG_PATH TEXT DEFAULT NULL , DESCRIPTION TEXT DEFAULT NULL , PUSH_ENABLED INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL , FONT_SIZE TEXT DEFAULT 'md'
, CONSTRAINT UK_USER_PROVIDER_ID UNIQUE (PROVIDER, ID) , CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_USER_ID UNIQUE (ID) , CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_USER_UID UNIQUE (UID) , CONSTRAINT CK_MB_USER_ENABLED CHECK (ENABLED IN (0,1)) , CONSTRAINT CK_MB_USER_PUSH_ENABLED CHECK (PUSH_ENABLED IN (0,1)) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_USER_LOGIN_RECORD ( CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , IP TEXT NOT NULL , DEVICE TEXT NOT NULL , MODEL TEXT DEFAULT NULL
, CONSTRAINT FK_MB_USER_LOGIN_RECORD_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_TOPIC ( TOPIC_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT , CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL , UPDATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL , OWNER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , ENABLED INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL , UID TEXT NOT NULL , EXTERNAL INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL , EMOTION INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL , COMMENTS INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL , MAX_LEN INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL , NAME TEXT NOT NULL , NAME_UPPER TEXT NOT NULL , DESCRIPTION TEXT DEFAULT NULL , IMOGI TEXT DEFAULT NULL , COLOR TEXT DEFAULT NULL , EMOJI_SET_TYPE INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 , AI INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL , PROMPT TEXT DEFAULT NULL
, CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_TOPIC_UID UNIQUE (UID) , CONSTRAINT FK_MB_TOPIC_OWNER_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (OWNER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO) , CONSTRAINT CK_MB_TOPIC_ENABLED CHECK (ENABLED IN (0,1)) , CONSTRAINT CK_MB_TOPIC_EXTERNAL CHECK (EXTERNAL IN (0,1)) , CONSTRAINT CK_MB_TOPIC_EMOTION CHECK (EMOTION IN (0,1)) , CONSTRAINT CK_MB_TOPIC_COMMENTS CHECK (COMMENTS IN (0,1)) , CONSTRAINT CK_MB_TOPIC_AI CHECK (AI IN (0,1)) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_TOPIC_FOLLOW ( USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , TOPIC_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
, PRIMARY KEY (USER_NO, TOPIC_NO) , CONSTRAINT FK_TOPIC_FOLLOW_USER FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE , CONSTRAINT FK_TOPIC_FOLLOW_TOPIC FOREIGN KEY (TOPIC_NO) REFERENCES MB_TOPIC(TOPIC_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_TOPIC_STATS ( TOPIC_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, FOLLOW_COUNT INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, FRAGMENT_COUNT INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, COMMENT_COUNT INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, LAST_FRAGMENT_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NULL, LAST_COMMENT_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NULL, UPDATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
CONSTRAINT FK_MB_TOPIC_STATS_TOPIC_NO FOREIGN KEY (TOPIC_NO) REFERENCES MB_TOPIC(TOPIC_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_FRAGMENT ( FRAGMENT_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT , CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , UPDATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , TOPIC_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , IS_DELETED INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 , UID TEXT NOT NULL , CONTENT TEXT NOT NULL , IP TEXT DEFAULT NULL , DEVICE TEXT DEFAULT NULL
, CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_FRAGMENT_UID UNIQUE (UID) , CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FRAGMENT_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE , CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FRAGMENT_TOPIC_NO FOREIGN KEY (TOPIC_NO) REFERENCES MB_TOPIC(TOPIC_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE , CONSTRAINT CK_MB_FRAGMENT_IS_DELETED CHECK (IS_DELETED IN (0,1)) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS ( COMMENT_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT , CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , UPDATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , FRAGMENT_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , IS_DELETED INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 , UID TEXT NOT NULL , CONTENT TEXT NOT NULL , IP TEXT DEFAULT NULL , DEVICE TEXT DEFAULT NULL
, CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS_UID UNIQUE (UID) , CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS_FRAGMENT_NO FOREIGN KEY (FRAGMENT_NO) REFERENCES MB_FRAGMENT(FRAGMENT_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE , CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE , CONSTRAINT CK_MB_FRAGMENT_COMMENTS_IS_DELETED CHECK (IS_DELETED IN (0,1)) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_FRAGMENT_SCRAP ( CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , UPDATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , FRAGMENT_NO INTEGER NOT NULL
, PRIMARY KEY (USER_NO, FRAGMENT_NO) , CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FRAGMENT_SCRAP_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE , CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FRAGMENT_SCRAP_FRAGMENT_NO FOREIGN KEY (FRAGMENT_NO) REFERENCES MB_FRAGMENT(FRAGMENT_NO) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_FRAGMENT_EMOTION_LOG ( EMOTION_LOG_ID INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT , CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , UPDATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , TARGET_TYPE INTEGER NOT NULL , TARGET_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , EMOTION TEXT NOT NULL
, CONSTRAINT FK_MB_EMOLOG_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE , CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_EMOLOG_ONE_PER_USER UNIQUE (USER_NO, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_NO) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG ( TAG_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT , NAME TEXT NOT NULL
, CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG_NAME UNIQUE (NAME) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG_RECORD ( TAG_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , FRAGMENT_NO INTEGER NOT NULL
, PRIMARY KEY (TAG_NO, FRAGMENT_NO) , CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG_RECORD_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (TAG_NO) REFERENCES MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG(TAG_NO) , CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FRAGMENT_HASHTAG_RECORD_FRAGMENT_NO FOREIGN KEY (FRAGMENT_NO) REFERENCES MB_FRAGMENT(FRAGMENT_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_PUSH_SUB ( SUB_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT , CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL , UPDATED_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL , USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL , END_POINT TEXT NOT NULL , P256DH TEXT NOT NULL , AUTH TEXT NOT NULL , IS_ACTIVE INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL , DEVICE_ID TEXT , USER_AGENT TEXT , BROWSER TEXT , OS TEXT , LAST_PUSH_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NULL , FAIL_COUNT INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL , EXPIRATION_TIME INTEGER DEFAULT NULL
, CONSTRAINT FK_MB_PUSH_SUB_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE , CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_PUSH_SUB_END_POINT UNIQUE (END_POINT) , CONSTRAINT CK_MB_PUSH_SUB_IS_ACTIVE CHECK (IS_ACTIVE IN (0,1)) );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_SHARE ( SHARE_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT , CREATE_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , UID TEXT NOT NULL , USER_NO INTEGER DEFAULT 0 , TARGET_TYPE INTEGER NOT NULL -- 0:Topic, 1:Board, 2:Comment , TARGET_NO INTEGER NOT NULL
, CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_SHARE_UID UNIQUE (UID) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_HOLIDAY ( HOLIDAY_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, CREATE_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, HOLI_TYPE INTEGER NOT NULL, LOC_DATE TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, HOLIDAY INTEGER NOT NULL, NAME TEXT NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT CK_MB_HOLIDAY_HOLIDAY CHECK (HOLIDAY IN (0,1)) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_ALARM ( ALARM_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, CREATE_AT TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UID TEXT NOT NULL, MAKE_SOURCE TEXT NOT NULL, READ_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NULL, ALARM_TYPE TEXT NOT NULL, USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL, TITLE TEXT NOT NULL, MESSAGE TEXT NOT NULL, URL TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_ALARM_UID UNIQUE (UID), CONSTRAINT FK_MB_ALARM_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_USER_PROFILE ( USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPD_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, MIME_TYPE TEXT, IMAGE BLOB NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT FK_MB_USER_PROFILE_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO) ON DELETE CASCADE )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_FEEDBACK ( FEEDBACK_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPD_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CHECK_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT NULL, USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL, FEEDBACK_TYPE TEXT, TITLE TEXT NOT NULL, CONTENT TEXT NOT NULL, NEED_FEEDBACK INTEGER DEFAULT 0, MIME_TYPE TEXT DEFAULT NULL, SUGGEST_FILE BLOB NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FEEDBACK_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO), CONSTRAINT CK_MB_FEEDBACK_NEED_FEEDBACK CHECK (NEED_FEEDBACK IN (0,1) OR NEED_FEEDBACK IS NULL) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_FRAGMENT_IMAGE ( IMAGE_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPD_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
UID TEXT NOT NULL, FRAGMENT_NO INTEGER NOT NULL, USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL, IMAGE_ORDER INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, MIME_TYPE TEXT NOT NULL, STORAGE_NAME TEXT NOT NULL, ORIGINAL_NAME TEXT NOT NULL, WIDTH INTEGER NOT NULL, HEIGHT INTEGER NOT NULL, FILE_SIZE INTEGER NOT NULL,
CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_FRAGMENT_IMAGE_UID UNIQUE (UID), CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_FRAGMENT_IMAGE_STORAGE_NAME UNIQUE (STORAGE_NAME), CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_FRAGMENT_IMAGE_FRAGMENT_ORDER UNIQUE (FRAGMENT_NO, IMAGE_ORDER), CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FRAGMENT_IMAGE_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO), CONSTRAINT FK_MB_FRAGMENT_IMAGE_FRAGMENT_NO FOREIGN KEY (FRAGMENT_NO) REFERENCES MB_FRAGMENT(FRAGMENT_NO) )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS MB_TOPIC_INVITE_USER ( TOPIC_INVITE_NO INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, CREATED_AT TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPD_DATE TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UID TEXT NOT NULL, TOPIC_NO INTEGER NOT NULL, SOURCE_USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL, TARGET_USER_NO INTEGER NOT NULL, IS_ACCEPT INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
CONSTRAINT UQ_MB_TOPIC_INVITE_USER_UID UNIQUE (UID), CONSTRAINT FK_MB_TOPIC_INVITE_USER_SOURCE_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (SOURCE_USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO), CONSTRAINT FK_MB_TOPIC_INVITE_USER_TARGET_USER_NO FOREIGN KEY (TARGET_USER_NO) REFERENCES MB_USER(USER_NO), CONSTRAINT FK_MB_TOPIC_INVITE_USER_TOPIC_NO FOREIGN KEY (TOPIC_NO) REFERENCES MB_TOPIC(TOPIC_NO), CONSTRAINT CK_MB_TOPIC_INVITE_USER_IS_ACCEPT CHECK (IS_ACCEPT IN (0,1) OR IS_ACCEPT IS NULL) )
